seo.title: SpotNodes — Software Engineering Studio
seo.description: SpotNodes is a software engineering studio building web platforms, Android apps and Web3 interfaces that hold up in production. Quality engineering, honest pricing, real delivery.

hero.sub: From web platforms to Android apps and Web3 products — we take ideas from first sketch to production, with quality you can measure and a team that treats your product like its own.

visual.mainAlt: ZOOOX — cashback and spend analytics platform

work.label: 01 — Work
work.sub: A selection of recent projects — designed, engineered and shipped to real users.

featured.title: ZOOOX
featured.summary: Cashback and spend analytics that turn everyday purchases into money back and clear insight.
featured.description: ZOOOX is a production-grade cashback and spend-analytics platform. It connects to a user's email, extracts transactions automatically and turns them into interactive dashboards — engineered to stay fast on large datasets and real-time updates, on mobile and web.

featured.title: Buckmint DEX
featured.summary: A decentralised exchange interface with wallet connection, live trading and portfolio tracking.
featured.description: A modern Web3 decentralised exchange: seamless wallet connection, token trading with dynamic token-aware charts, portfolio tracking with live P&L, and full transaction history. Built for real-time crypto trading with a responsive, dark-mode-first interface.

featured.title: Book Transpo
featured.summary: Logistics and ride booking with live tracking, route optimisation and scalable workflows.
featured.description: A logistics and ride-booking platform engineered for real-time operations: live tracking, route optimisation and frictionless booking, with deep mapping integration for accurate navigation and location intelligence — backed by a secure, real-time backend.

featured.title: Umrah Chalo
featured.summary: A deployed travel-booking platform built for seamless UX under real user traffic.
featured.description: A real-world travel platform for discovering and booking Umrah packages. Designed for clarity and responsiveness across devices, with a booking flow built for real traffic — production-ready from day one.
features: Seamless booking UX for real traffic

services.label: 02 — Services
services.sub: Four disciplines, one standard: production-grade quality. Pick one, or hand us the whole product.

items.title: Web Engineering
items.description: Marketing sites, dashboards and full platforms — fast to load, fast to use, and built on stacks your team can grow with.

items.title: App Engineering
items.description: Native Android and cross-platform apps engineered for performance, offline reality and store readiness — from build to Play Store release.

items.title: Game Engineering
items.description: Interactive 3D and browser-based experiences with real-time rendering, physics and the performance budgets to match.

items.title: ASO & Growth
items.description: Getting found is engineering too. Store listings, keyword strategy and conversion tuning that turn installs into users.

process.label: 03 — Process
process.sub: A tight, transparent loop — you see working software every week, not a big reveal at the end.

steps.title: Discover
steps.description: We start with your business, not your backlog — goals, users and constraints understood before a line of code exists.

steps.title: Architect
steps.description: The right stack for the job, a system designed to scale, and milestones you can actually hold us to.

steps.title: Build
steps.description: Short cycles, working software every week, and a codebase your future team won't hate us for.

steps.title: Harden
steps.description: QA, performance profiling and security passes — until it survives everything we can throw at it.

steps.title: Ship
steps.description: Deployment, monitoring and post-launch support. Launch day is the starting line, not the finish.

studio.label: 04 — Studio
studio.manifesto: Great software comes from ownership. The people who scope your product are the people who design, build and ship it — every requirement, every commit, every deploy. No handoffs, no telephone game, nothing lost in translation.

principles.title: Engineers up front
principles.body: You speak directly with the people writing your code — decisions happen in minutes, not through layers of account management.

principles.title: Production or it doesn't count
principles.body: Demos impress in a meeting; software earns trust in production. We ship things that survive real users and real traffic.

principles.title: Honest scope, honest price
principles.body: We quote what a build actually takes — no padding, no surprise invoices, and no cutting corners to hit a number.
